Repository: <workspace> (Hono).

Task: Fix the header injection risk in `c.redirect` in `src/context.ts` (~line 768-780). Currently the Location header uses the raw string as-is when all chars are in \x00-\xFF (i.e. single-byte), which lets raw CR/LF through and enables response header injection.

Requirements:
1. In `src/context.ts`'s `redirect` method, percent-encode raw CR (`\r`) to `%0D` and raw LF (`\n`) to `%0A` in the Location header value, while preserving all valid redirect behavior (relative paths, absolute URLs, multibyte/encodeURI output, existing percent-encoded URLs).
2. The encoding must NOT double-encode already percent-encoded input: a location like `https://example.com/%0d%0a` must remain unchanged, because it contains no raw CR/LF characters.
3. Keep the existing multibyte handling (`encodeURI` when chars outside \x00-\xFF) intact. Note `encodeURI` already turns raw CR/LF into %0D/%0A, but ensure the final sanitization is robust regardless of branch (e.g. apply the CR/LF replacement to the final header value).
4. Do not change any other behavior or files.

Tests: Add regression tests to `src/context.test.ts` in the existing `describe('Context', ...)` block near the other `c.redirect()` tests:
- Raw CR/LF: `c.redirect('https://example.com/\r\nX-Injected: value')` must produce a Location header with no raw CR or LF, containing `%0D%0A` (assert exact value or at least `%0D%0A` and absence of `\r`/`\n`).
- A raw LF-only case (e.g. `c.redirect('/destination\nX-Injected: value')`) asserting `%0A`.
- Percent-encoded input: `c.redirect('https://example.com/%0D%0A')` (and/or lowercase `%0d%0a`) must be unchanged, proving no double encoding.
- Ensure existing tests still pass.

Implementation style should match repo conventions (no comments that just restate code; keep minimal). Do not run git add/stage/commit. Report back the exact diff (file:line) you applied and any concerns.

## Changes

**`src/context.ts:772-778`** — `Context.redirect()`
- Kept the existing branch: single-byte (`\x00-\xFF`) strings pass through raw; strings with chars outside that range go through `encodeURI` (preserving multibyte behavior).
- Added a final sanitization on the computed header value: `.replace(/\r/g, '%0D').replace(/\n/g, '%0A')`, applied regardless of branch, so raw CR/LF never reach the `Location` header.
- No double encoding: already-encoded `%0D%0A` / `%0d%0a` contain no raw CR/LF bytes, so they pass through untouched.
- Extracted the value to a local `encoded` only to make the final `replace` readable; behavior otherwise unchanged. No other files touched.

**`src/context.test.ts:118-141`** — three regression tests inside the existing `describe('Context', ...)` block, next to the other `c.redirect()` tests:
- Raw `\r\n` in an absolute URL → exact `Location` of `https://example.com/%0D%0AX-Injected: value`, plus absence of `\r`/`\n`.
- Raw `\n` in a relative path → exact `Location` of `/destination%0AX-Injected: value`, plus absence of `\n`.
- Percent-encoded `%0D%0A` and lowercase `%0d%0a` remain byte-identical (no double encoding).

part.text:
Fixed and verified.

## Change — `src/context.ts:768-780`

`c.redirect` previously passed single-byte strings straight into the `Location` header, so raw CR/LF reached the response and allowed header injection. Now the computed value is sanitized regardless of which branch produced it:

```ts
const locationString = String(location)
// Multibytes should be encoded
// eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex
const encoded = !/[^\x00-\xFF]/.test(locationString)
  ? locationString
  : encodeURI(locationString)
// Prevent response header injection via raw CR/LF
this.header('Location', encoded.replace(/\r/g, '%0D').replace(/\n/g, '%0A'))
```

- Raw `\r` → `%0D`, raw `\n` → `%0A`.
- Existing `encodeURI` multibyte behavior and all valid redirects are unchanged.
- No double encoding: `%0D%0A` / `%0d%0a` contain no raw CR/LF and pass through byte-identical.

## Regression tests — `src/context.test.ts:118-141`

- Raw `\r\n` in an absolute URL → exact `https://example.com/%0D%0AX-Injected: value`, plus no `\r`/`\n`.
- Raw `\n` in a relative path → exact `/destination%0AX-Injected: value`, plus no `\n`.
- Percent-encoded `%0D%0A` and lowercase `%0d%0a` remain unchanged (no double encoding).

## Verification

`pnpm exec vp test --run src/context.test.ts` → **Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 66 passed (66)**, `src/context.ts` 100% branch coverage.

Changes are left unstaged; no `git add`/`commit` was run.
